args.text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?

Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug, in this channel. You wrote that both inbound lanes at Vantorre's Hartford plant showed a white screen after badge scan.

In your message the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. That is the only thing in the channel about what the guard was doing before the kiosks came back. Mateo said six trucks were waiting at the east gate at 10:44.

Mateo posted at 11:03 that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. At 11:08 you wrote that both lanes were working as of 11:07.

Nothing in the channel covers the guard's actions after 10:42 beyond the clipboard. If the postmortem needs that, it would have to come from Vantorre or the guard directly.
And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?

Ruth, it's INC-4821. Gideon wrote in this channel at 11:08 AM on 3 Aug that the screenshot was attached to that ticket. He was chasing Mateo's status-page access problem at the time.

That is only what the channel says. I haven't opened the ticket itself, so I can't confirm the screenshot is there.
